info.title: Duet Ledger API
info.description: Duet Ledger web session API and scoped external /api/v1 app-password API. Amounts are integer strings. API access defaults off; an administrator must enable it. Every external request intersects the app-password account allowlist with current user access. Remote MCP is available at /mcp using the same app-password permissions.

post.description: Available only before the first account exists. The first account becomes administrator; later requests return 409. Create this account before exposing the server publicly.
A valid sharing or account-only invitation, or an enabled public signup setting, is required. New accounts are never administrators. Sharing invitations still require owner approval.

parameters.name: trash
parameters.description: Only the caller own trashed ledgers are returned.

delete.summary: Owner moves a ledger and its accounts to recoverable trash
delete.description: All access to accounts and receipts is suspended until restore. Pending ledger/account invitations are cancelled.

delete.summary: Owner moves an account to recoverable trash
delete.description: Hides this account and its postings/receipts from every user. Transfer counterpart balance remains intact. Pending account invitations are cancelled. Existing grants resume on restore.

parameters.name: display_currency
parameters.description: Convert totals/categories/daily and add item display_currency/display_scale and leg display_amount. Original amounts and account currencies stay unchanged. Items without a conversion rate are listed in missing_currencies and excluded from converted aggregates.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Reusing a key with different inputs returns 409.

post.description: New manual transactions accept only income, expense and transfer. Existing refund/adjustment data and migration imports remain compatible.
